audit.note: client-composed MESSAGE_TOAST per Link, no round-trip

deviations.what: the sample's whole point is the currentLocation aggregation of sap.m.Breadcrumbs (since UI5 1.123), which shows the current page as a Link instead of plain text - kept 1:1, so the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.123 to render it there (on an older release the whole VIEW fails to load). (Corrected 2026-08-23: sap.m.Breadcrumbs has no items aggregation at all - its aggregations are links (@1.34, the default) and currentLocation (@1.123) - and XMLTemplateProcessor does not fall back to the default aggregation for an unknown named element: it tries to instantiate sap.m.currentLocation as a control and throws. The declared floor itself was right.)

each Link keeps the original's client-side MessageToast.show(evt.getSource().getText() + ' has been clicked') as a roundtrip-free follow_up_action MESSAGE_TOAST with the template '{0} has been clicked' filled by ${$source>/text} - the text comes from the pressed Link itself, exactly as in the original, and nothing travels to the backend. The class therefore has no on_event and no model at all.
